thread:
maria: quick design check — I'm not thrilled with the current org vs project toggle on the Usage page. It's visually noisy and hurts scan time.

sam: agree. the toggle being inline with the chart legend is confusing. users keep mistaking it for a filter. :confused:

jayden: +1. proposal: move scope control to the top-left, left-align with page header, and simplify label to 'Scope: Organization / Project' (instead of 'Switch view').

ellen: that helps. also the token breakdown chips are tiny — they fail WCAG contrast on hover. contrast ratio ~2.8:1 right now. we need >=3:1 for hover states at least.

ravi: for token breakdown, what about making the chips stacked vertically in compact mode? preserves width for charts and still shows totals.

lucy-design: mock updated — moved scope to top-left, added clearer label, and made chips 16px taller. paste: https://redwood.internal/proto/usage-scope-top-left (preview)

maria: nice work. two copy nits: change 'Organization' to 'Account' in header to match billing language, and use sentence case for the chip labels.

sam: flag for product: switching to 'Account' impacts invoices page language — finance wants consistency. tagging @finance-bot for a quick check.

finance-bot: automated note: glossary term "Account" currently maps to billing.account in invoices; recommended. Please confirm if UI change is approved by finance ops.

jayden: confirmed — finance ops OK with 'Account' as long as we keep 'Project' for workspaces.

ellen: accessibility follow-ups: 1) add aria-label="scope selector" to the toggle, 2) ensure the chart color palette passes 4.5:1 for small elements (legends/chips). Example CSS tweak: 
```css
.legend-item { color: #1f2937; /* update to meet contrast */ }
```

maria: also thinking about invoices link placement — current position is under the spend chart and gets scrolled past. Suggest a persistent CTA near the scope selector: 'Download invoice' dropdown w/ date range.

lucy-design: can add a compact invoice CTA next to scope. mock shows a small down caret and month selector. Works in desktop but might be heavy for mobile.

sam: mobile fallback: hide CTA and show a sticky banner at bottom on invoice-eligible pages.

ravi: performance note: adding a persistent dropdown increases DOM size; prefer lazy-render the dropdown on first open and keep aria-expanded management. pseudo: `renderInvoiceDropdown && <InvoiceDropdown />`

maria: good call — lazy render + aria props. last UX ask: change spend chart sparkline tooltip copy from 'tokens' to 'token usage' for clarity.

ellen: small copy tweak accepted. also run a quick screen-reader pass on the sparkline tooltip — NVDA reads the label now as 'chart one', need descriptive IDs.

jayden: I'll update mocks and hand off to eng for a11y checklist: `aria-labels, keyboard nav, focus states, contrast`.

sam: timeline? can we get an eng spike this week and a follow-up design review next Tue?

maria: yes — spike by Thursday, review Tuesday 10am. I'll add to calendar and create a short doc with acceptance criteria.

lucy-design: leaving a final note: when we compact the chips, let's ensure the token color ordering remains stable between org/project to avoid cognitive load.

maria: perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

(archival note: thread summarizes layout/label+a11y+invoice-CTA decisions for usage dashboard iteration v2)
